from pilot.log_status import append_status

    {"agent":"Explorer I","join":35, "eval":38, "announce":38, "mail":None, "notes":"Eval at 38; announced in Capsule #3."},
]
for e in entries:
    append_status(e)
print("Appended collaborator statuses.")
